hypothesis: Clarifying task continuity reduces incorrect unknown intent predictions while retaining preference and unrelated-request accuracy.
decision_rule: Evaluate this single frozen prompt before any further tuning. If original-suite snapshot exact accuracy is at least 98%, preference accuracy remains 100%, and unrelated-question accuracy is unchanged, retain the prompt-only approach. Otherwise document remaining failures before changing state representation. Fresh synthetic cases are authored by the implementing agent after v1 diagnosis and are not an independent blinded holdout.
execution: Serial requests and serial passes. Original suite order rotates by repetition; fresh snapshot prompt order alternates by repetition. No turn retries. Up to three whole-pass attempts on malformed/invalid model output only, preserving all prefixes. HTTP/transport/configuration failures stop the experiment. Never mix prompt variants in original-suite summary.
